cv_processor_reason: Hand tracking is essential for monitoring the user's interaction with the pan, egg, and bread throughout the sandwich preparation process.
description: A simple guide to preparing a delicious egg sandwich.
name: Make an Egg Sandwich

common_errors: Pan is too hot and smoking
Not enough butter/oil added
Pan is off-center on the burner
steps.instruction: Place a frying pan on the stove and add a small amount of butter or cooking oil. Turn the heat to medium.
steps.visual_cue: A pan is on the stove with butter or oil melting/heating; heat dial is set to medium.

common_errors: Eggshell pieces fall into the pan
Egg yolk breaks upon cracking
Forgetting to season the egg
Cracking the egg too forcefully
Egg running off to the side of the pan
steps.instruction: Crack the egg directly into the heated pan. Season the egg with a pinch of salt and pepper.
steps.visual_cue: An egg is cooking in the pan, with visible seasoning on top.

common_errors: Egg is overcooked and rubbery
Egg is undercooked with raw whites
Sticking the egg to the pan
Splattering oil when flipping
Burning hands on the pan
Egg breaks when flipping
steps.instruction: Cook the egg to your desired doneness, flipping once if making a fried egg, then remove from heat and place the cooked egg on a plate.
steps.visual_cue: The cooked egg is fully set or has a runny yolk as desired, and is resting on a clean plate.

common_errors: Egg falls off the bread slice
Bread is torn or crumbled
Using only one slice of bread
steps.instruction: Place two slices of bread on a clean surface. Carefully transfer the cooked egg onto one slice of bread.
steps.visual_cue: Two slices of bread are on the surface, and the cooked egg is centered on one of them.

common_errors: Top slice of bread is misaligned
Ingredients spill out the sides when pressing
Pressing too hard and squishing the sandwich
steps.instruction: Place the second slice of bread on top of the egg, creating the sandwich. Gently press down to secure the contents.
steps.visual_cue: A complete sandwich is formed with the egg neatly enclosed between two slices of bread.
